# Import terenu do Roblox Studia

Terrain Editor -> **Import**. Heightmapa je 16bit grayscale PNG,
colormapa 8bit RGB. Cisla nize jsou z sidecar JSONu vedle kazde PNG.

**Y je centrovane**: cerna = `Position.Y - Size.Y/2`, bila = `Position.Y + Size.Y/2`.
Pri `Position.Y = Size.Y/2` sedi nejnizsi bod areny presne na `Y = 0`.

## Import po pasech

Import dialog odmita regiony nad 2^32 voxelu (16384 x 1024 x 16384
studu / 4^3). Plnovyske areny se proto importuji po pasech podel Z -
kazdy pas je vlastni PNG + vlastni Size/Position, poradi je jedno.
Pasy se o kousek prekryvaji, aby na svech nevznikaly bryzdy.
Y je u vsech pasu stejne - normalizace vysky je globalni.

## Merítko

| Arena | Vyrez | m/px | study/m vodorovne | study/m svisle | Prelet Z-V |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aconcagua | 47 x 56 km | 32.1 | 0.350 | 0.68 | 2:17 min |
| Beskydy | 40 x 33 km | 24.8 | 0.412 | 0.68 | 2:17 min |
| Everest | 49 x 33 km | 33.8 | 0.333 | 0.68 | 2:17 min |
| Kilimanjaro | 39 x 33 km | 38.2 | 0.421 | 0.68 | 2:17 min |
| Rocky Mountains | 34 x 39 km | 29.2 | 0.482 | 0.68 | 2:17 min |
| Mont Blanc | 39 x 39 km | 26.6 | 0.423 | 0.68 | 2:17 min |

**Prevyseni** je svisle merítko deleno vodorovnym: `1.00` = hora ma
skutecne proporce, `0.30` = je splostela na tretinu. Sedi to s planem
(vsechny areny ~400-600 studu vysoke), ale hory jsou tim placatejsi nez
ve skutecnosti. Zvysit lze `--studs-per-meter-y`, nebo zmensit arenu
pres `--arena-studs`.

## Colormapa -> materialy

Colormapa je natvrdo obarvena presnymi RGB vychozich `Terrain.MaterialColors`
(vytazeno z `RobloxStudio.app/Contents/Resources/PlatformContent/pc/terrain/materials.json`),
takze importer prirazuje materialy bez dalsiho nastavovani. Zadne prechody
ani dithering - michana barva by spadla na cizi material.

- **Aconcagua**: Ground 53%, Rock 40%, Mud 7%, Snow 1%
- **Beskydy**: LeafyGrass 82%, Grass 18%
- **Everest**: Snow 65%, Rock 35%, Ground 1%
- **Kilimanjaro**: LeafyGrass 46%, Ground 38%, Rock 8%, Sand 7%, Snow 1%
- **Rocky Mountains**: Grass 62%, Rock 22%, LeafyGrass 16%
- **Mont Blanc**: Rock 36%, Ground 31%, Grass 21%, Snow 7%, LeafyGrass 4%, Glacier 0%
